Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@bridgepoint.io>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BridgePoint / Redwood - initial access & roles coordination

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — BridgePoint is excited to get started. We're kicking off the internal work to provision the new Redwood workspace and want to align on roles, API access, and the first project boundaries. High level asks: 

- We'd like service accounts for two environments: staging and production (names below).
- Scoped API keys for deployment pipelines (CI service account).
- A small admin roster (3 people) + development roster (6 people) and suggested RBAC mapping.
- Any pre-reqs for KMS/HSM integration for production keys.

I've attached a CSV with our initial mapping. Can you confirm the recommended admin vs developer roles in Redwood and whether we should provision ephemeral keys during deploys or seed long-lived service keys? Also please confirm the expected timing for the initial API key handoff so we can schedule our infra sprint.

Attachment: bridgepoint_project_roles.csv (csv)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

— Allyson
Allyson Park
Head of Platform Engineering
BridgePoint
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Allyson Park <allyson@bridgepoint.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 10:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BridgePoint / Redwood - initial access & roles coordination

Allyson — thanks for the CSV and clear asks. Quick confirmation and an outline of next steps from our side: 

1) Roles and RBAC
- "Admin" role: workspace-level admin for billing, invitations, model pinning. Recommend 3 people (ok to include your security lead).
- "Developer" role: create projects, request API keys for services, view logs. We recommend 6 as you suggested.
- "Read-only" observers: for SRE/Compliance — optional.

2) Keys and service accounts
- For CI/CD we recommend short-lived API tokens backed by a service account + automated rotation via your pipeline (we can provide tooling examples). For initial rollout we can seed a production service account with a long-lived provisioning key that you rotate once automation is in place.

3) KMS/HSM
- We support customer-managed key wrapping for production secrets (bring-your-own-kms). We'll need the KMS key ARN and an IAM role for Redwood's provisioning agent; Soojin can follow up with the precise IAM policy.

4) Timeline
- If we get final role roster + CSV updates by EOD Wed (6/11) we can pre-provision the staging service account and issue ephemeral staging tokens on Thu. Production seeding would be gated on signed contract addendum (DocuSign link below) and KMS info.

I've added Monica (CS) for the implementation plan and Soojin (Solutions) for the KMS/IAM details. I've also created a short onboarding playbook (internal) and linked it here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcBridgePointOnboard

If that schedule works, I'll open the provisioning ticket and share expected handoff artifacts (API key vault location, admin invite list, service account names).

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick technical follow-up with the GitHub Actions snippet and the minimal IAM policy we need for KMS key access. Pasted below is a minimal example; we'll send a formatted policy and a verification checklist to Allyson's infra alias once you share the KMS ARN.

--- GitHub Actions example (conceptual) ---
- Step 1: Request short-lived token from Redwood token endpoint using CI service account + provisioning key.
- Step 2: Use token to pull model artifacts / call inference API in CI job.
- Step 3: Rotate token after job or at defined TTL.

Minimal IAM trust snippet (placeholder for your cloud):
- Allow sts:AssumeRole for redwood-provisioner@redwood to decrypt/wrap using the KMS key ARN provided.

I'll attach the policy template in a follow-up and open the infra verification ticket once we receive the ARN at it@bridgepoint.io.

Attachment: (policy-template.json) — will send as follow-up via Drive link.

Looking forward — I'll also add the calendar invite for Mon 6/16 10:00 PT (walkthrough).

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer
